command: kubectl get pods,deployments,statefulsets,daemonsets,cronjobs -n wiki-87b7 -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec != null) | .metadata.name + ": " + (.spec.template.spec.volumes[]?.configMap.name // "none" | tostring)' 2>/dev/null || kubectl get all -n wiki-87b7 -o json | jq -r '.. | .configMap?.name? // empty' | sort -u
kubectl get all -n wiki-87b7 -o json | grep -o '"configMap":{"name":"[^"]*"' | grep -o '"name":"[^"]*' | cut -d'"' -f4 | sort -u
kubectl get pods,deployments,statefulsets,daemonsets,cronjobs -n wiki-87b7 -o yaml | grep -A 2 "configMap:" | grep "name:"
kubectl describe deployment wikiweb -n wiki-87b7 | grep -A 20 "Volumes:" | head -25
kubectl delete configmap import-rules page-templates-2023 theme -n wiki-87b7
kubectl get deployment wikiweb -n wiki-87b7 -o yaml | grep -A 100 "volumes:"
kubectl get pods -n wiki-87b7 -o yaml | grep -E "(configMapRef|configMapKeyRef|name: theme)" -A 2 -B 2
kubectl get pods -n wiki-87b7 -o yaml | grep -i theme
kubectl delete configmap import-rules page-templates-2023 -n wiki-87b7
kubectl delete configmap import-rules page-templates-2023 -n wiki-87b7
